To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a compound plate, consisting of a slit carbon plate, slit ferrite and slit copper plate, exhibits polarization characteristics, and that the polarization characteristics can be improved by the appropriate combination of the slit ferrite and the slit copper plates.
the polarization characteristics of a slit carbon plate can be improved by the superposition slit ferrite and a copper plates.
the polarization characteristics of a slit carbon plate can be improved by the superposition a slit ferrite and a copper plates over the carbon plate, in the frequency range of 1 MHz-800 MHz.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a carbon plate that displays polarization characteristics.
the development of a plate that exhibits polarization in the far field.
the development of a plate with polarization characteristics for the effective RF magnetic shielding of electromagnetic waves.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the compound plate has the potential to improve the polarization characteristics of a slit carbon plate.
the polarization characteristics of a carbon plate were improved by the superposition method.
the superposition of the slit ferrite and slit copper plates over the carbon plate, in the present paper, has improved the polarization characteristics of a slit carbon plate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the superposition of the slit carbon, ferrite, and copper plates can effectively improve the polarization characteristics of slit carbon plate, and the compound plate can be applied to RF magnetic shielding.
the polarization characteristics of a carbon plate could be improved by the superposition over the carbon plate of a slit ferrite plate and slit copper plate.
the superposition of a slit ferrite plate over a slit carbon plate, and then a slit copper plate, is the most effective method for improving the polarization characteristics of a slit carbon plate.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the compound plate has polarization characteristics, and that the value of the difference between the RF shielding degrees for the orientations of the slits is improved by approximately 30 dB at 30 MHz.
the compound plates are effective for RF magnetic shielding, in particular, in the frequency regions of 1 MHz-30 MHz and 100 MHz-800 MHz.
polarization characteristics can be obtained by the superposition, over a carbon plate, of a slit ferrite plate and slit copper plate.
